name: Tachie ga Hen na Pose no Ren'ai Adventure
original_name: 立ち絵が変なポーズの恋愛アドベンチャー
source:
All the characters are in strange poses, but that's normal for this game. A school romance novel game set in a strange world.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2809960/_/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
人人都擺著奇怪的姿勢，可這在遊戲裡再正常不過。這是一個發生在古怪世界裡的校園戀愛視覺小說遊戲。

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2809960/_/]Steam[/url]］
